title: Real-Time AI Metrics & Executive Dashboards
description: Instrument .NET AI applications with System.Diagnostics.Metrics, aggregate token usage and latency histograms, and build real-time Grafana and Azure Monitor dashboards.

data.text: While logs provide rich individual event details, aggregate operational health is monitored via quantitative Metrics. Instead of parsing through gigabytes of text logs to compute average token spend or p95 response time, metrics record lightweight numeric time-series measurements directly in memory. In .NET, System.Diagnostics.Metrics provides the native runtime implementation for OpenTelemetry-compliant metrics.

rows: Monotonically increasing count of input, output, and cached tokens
Measures distribution and percentiles (P50, P90, P95, P99) of end-to-end completion latency
Measures Time to First Token across streaming client connections
Tracks concurrent active multi-turn agent loops currently running
Counts exceptions categorized by type (RateLimit429, Timeout, ContentFilter)

data.title: Executive AI Dashboard Grid
items: Real-Time Token Burn Rate: Time-series graph showing tokens consumed per minute across all models.
Latency Percentiles (P50 / P95 / P99): Tracks degradation under peak load; highlights when TTFT exceeds the 800ms threshold.
Tenant Spend Breakdown: Donut chart displaying top 10 cost-consuming enterprise tenants.
Error Rate & Throttle Gauge: Real-time alarm showing 429 quota rejections and circuit breaker activations.
Cache Hit Efficiency: Measures prompt caching savings (percentage of prompt tokens served from cache at reduced cost).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Metrics provide lightweight, real-time numeric time-series for high-level monitoring
Use System.Diagnostics.Metrics in .NET to declare standard counters, histograms, and gauges
Record dimensional tags (model, tenant_id, token_type) to enable drill-downs in Grafana
Monitor Time to First Token (TTFT) and P95 latency continuously against user SLOs
Export metrics via OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) to Azure Monitor or Prometheus
data.takeaway: Real-time metrics transform black-box AI models into transparent, measurable services. Building targeted Grafana dashboards ensures operations teams stay ahead of cost spikes and performance regressions.
